title: Realization of the smooth source, Tate word and purity maps
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $b,o,q$ be the specified strict-tower operations and coordinates. Let $g_X:X'\to X$, $g_Y:Y'\to Y$, $f:X\to Y$ and $f':X'\to Y'$ be a Cartesian scheme square with a compactification $c$ of $f$ and its prescribed Cartesian pullback. Assume $\ell$ is invertible in every residue field at all four vertices and both vertical maps are quasi-compact. Fix tower adjunction data $a$ and compatible integral data $s$, including the four normalized reduction/limit coordinates, actual support and right-adjoint comparisons, and their counit and pullback normalization equations. These are the data and functors of [def-pur-integral-geometric-comparison-data, det-sp-tower-exceptional-bc]. Assume $g_X$ is a scheme isomorphism. For any $d\ge0$ and SmoothPart $m$ on these same integral data, PurityPart relative to $m$ is nonempty. Thus there is a TateComparison whose reduction is exactly the ordered towerTateWord, together with the two natural purity isomorphisms into the specified right adjoints, each equal to the actual limit-of-tower-purity word of its smooth reconstruction followed by the unique counit-preserving right-adjoint comparison. This asserts no reindexing/total-limit theorem and no compact-support exchange identity.

proof.text:
apply completed-operation substitution to pullback, tensor with the actual
integral roots-of-unity line, and the even shift. The native pullback comparison is the
specified reduction counit, so the cofinal source formula is the SourceModel equation.
The root maps respect coefficient transitions; their inverse limit and tensor powers give
towerTate, and pullback composition, tensor and shift coherences give towerTateWord.
They are natural before localization, giving towerComparison. Reduce the integral ordered
word to obtain TateComparison.reduction. The reconstruction unit supplies realization and
its unit formula. The two smooth packages give source constructibility and their
purity_realization fields make the displayed limit-of-gamma words invertible. Their
naturality gives natural isomorphisms. Finally compose with rightAdjointUniq to the
specified right adjoints, preserving the counits. These are exactly the two
SmoothGammaRealization predicates. For d=0 the line and shift are their unit words;
no negative tensor power or inverse of a root map is required.
